study.definition: SPY adjusted daily return <= -2% AND VIX close daily change >= +20%
study.cooldown: At least 21 trading sessions between retained events
limitations: Historical association, not evidence that algorithms bought.
Events cluster; spaced sample shown separately.
Each horizon excludes incomplete future windows.
Adjusted SPY close is a total-return proxy; no costs or trading strategy.
Thresholds are illustrative and do not make this a calibrated forecast.
